page.title: Property testing a statechart
page.description: Replace unit tests with properties: generate worlds from seeds, find the run that breaks the chart, shrink it, and read its trace. In your browser.

hero.headline: Test properties, not runs
hero.lede: A unit test checks one run you thought of. A property holds for every run. Generate the runs, find the one that breaks, and shrink it. Everything on this page runs in your browser.

section.heading: 1. Write the chart
section.p: A payment charges a card, retries after 30 seconds of silence, and gives up after three attempts.

section.heading: 2. Make the world data
section.p: The chart only sees events. So a world is an array: does the service answer charge 1, charge 2, and so on.
Run [silence, answer] with tracing on. Select a row to see its transitions.

section.heading: 3. State the properties
section.p: Whatever the service does, the payment charges at most three times and gives up only after the third charge. It is paid only when the service answered.

section.heading: 4. Search a thousand worlds
section.p: A seed makes a world. The search runs seeds until one breaks a property, and the seed reproduces it.

section.heading: 5. Plant a bug
section.p: Retry while attempts < 4. A unit test that answers the first charge still passes.

section.heading: 6. Shrink the failure
section.p: Try smaller worlds until none still fails. What is left is the bug and nothing else.
The smallest world is empty: the service never answers. The trace shows a fourth charge at 90 seconds.

section.heading: 7. Run it in CI
section.p: The same module runs in Node.js and Bun. A failure names its seed.

section.heading: Go further
section.p: There is no library to install. The world, the properties, the generator, the search and the shrinker are 76 lines of your own code.

item.text: Late, duplicate and reordered answers are more entries in the array.
Generate the team chat's inputs. Every online member sees every post.
Spans are data. Assert on how a run got there, not only where it ended.
